row.problem_statement:
ResponseTypes.from_body() raises UnboundLocalError for lowercase_chunk

#### Description

When using `ResponseTypes.from_body()` to detect response types from body content, an `UnboundLocalError` is raised because `lowercase_chunk` is referenced before being defined.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from scrapy.responsetypes import ResponseTypes

responsetypes = ResponseTypes()

# This should return HtmlResponse but raises UnboundLocalError instead
html_body = b'<html><head><title>Hello</title></head>'
response_type = responsetypes.from_body(html_body)
```

The error occurs when trying to detect HTML content from body data. The method fails with:

```
UnboundLocalError: local variable 'lowercase_chunk' referenced before assignment
```

Expected behavior: Should return the appropriate response class (HtmlResponse for HTML content, XmlResponse for XML content, etc.) based on the body content analysis.
